description:
FOLK RENTAL OFFERING 

The advertised rent is exclusive of bills.  

The total monthly rent payable is £2,044 pcm, which includes utilities, superfast Wi-Fi, and council tax.   

Residents also benefit from a 24/7 on-site team, a programme of weekly resident events, and full access to communal facilities including a fully equipped gym, co-working area, cinema room, lounges, shared kitchens and rooftop terraces, all included in the one monthly charge. 

FOLK CO-LIVING

Folk homes are designed around you. You'll get everything you want and need from a home, and then some. Every space is filled with opportunities - you can drop into the high-spec gym, lead the review in book club, watch the latest film in the cinema, or just kick back solo. The choice is yours.

THE BUILDING

Florence Dock is London living at its finest. A few steps from the River Thames and just over 10 minutes walk from Clapham Junction and Wandsworth Town stations, your new home is perfectly situated to enjoy all the city has to offer. Enjoy your own studio apartment with access to huge shared spaces, including a cinema, co-working space and a fully-fitted gym and studio. Soak up the sunset with panoramic views of London from one of our four terraces, tuck yourself away with a good read in the Snug or sweat it out in our spinning studio. The choice is yours.

YOUR STUDIO

Your private studio apartment comes with a comfy double bed, a desk and a fully equipped kitchen with hob, combi oven and a breakfast bar. In your ensuite bathroom, the fittings and finishes are clean, modern and high-spec. All the home comforts are included - a Samsung TV, Hypnos mattress, waterfall shower, under-bed storage and plenty of built-in wardrobes. Getting in and out's easy and safe with your secure key card.

LOCATION

Florence Dock is perfectly situated to enjoy all London has to offer. Stay local for weekend walks along the river or head down to the new Battersea Power Station. Just over 10 minutes walk from Clapham Junction and Wandsworth Town stations, you can also make the most of the great train connections and take a day trip out of the city to the south coast.

EVENTS AND COMMUNITY 

Life at Folk goes beyond your front door. A weekly programme of events brings residents together, from fitness sessions and workshops to social evenings and local experiences. Whether you're looking to meet new people or simply enjoy the atmosphere, there's always something happening.

We will let you know upon enquiry and will discuss any alternative homes that are available.
